Volcano plot for a diff bundle

Source: R/plot-diff.R
plot_volcano.Rd

x-axis is effect (log2FC, beta, correlation, depending on the backend); y-axis is -log10(p_value) by default. Significant features (is_significant) are highlighted; the top top_n rows by (adjusted) p-value are labelled. Optionally supply label_features to force-label a specific set of feature symbols.

Usage

plot_volcano(
  bundle,
  top_n = 20,
  label_features = NULL,
  p_basis = c("adjusted", "raw"),
  effect_threshold = NULL,
  p_threshold = 0.05
)

Arguments

bundle

An analysis_bundle produced by run_diff().

top_n

Number of top features to label, ranked by p_basis.

label_features

Optional character vector of feature_symbol values to always label.

p_basis

Which p-value column to use for the y-axis, "adjusted" or "raw".

effect_threshold

Vertical reference line for absolute effect.

p_threshold

Horizontal reference p-value line (significance cutoff).

Value

A ggplot object.
